title: Mollification of a compactly supported continuous unit covector field
statement: Let P, n be natural numbers, Λ := Covector (Euclid P) n with operator norm ‖·‖, and |·| := covectorEuclideanNorm. Let V ⊆ ℝ^P be open. Let g : ℝ^P → Λ be continuous with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ V and |g(x)| ≤ 1 for every x. Let ε > 0. Then there is an n-form ω : ℝ^P → Λ that is C^∞ with compact support (IsTestForm ω), with tsupport ω ⊆ V, |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for every x, and |ω(x) − g(x)| ≤ ε for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (ε : ℝ), IsOpen V → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ V → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) → 0 < ε → ∃ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, IsTestForm ω ∧ tsupport ω ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x - g x) ≤ ε
